title: Cold rebuild: Greeter with a default
summary: Rebuild Greeter with a default from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Greeter with a default** in *Input and truthiness*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.explain: `or` returns the first truthy operand, or the last one if none is truthy (so `[]`). `and` returns the last operand when all are truthy.

prompt: Read a name and an age on two lines.
- If the name line is blank (or only spaces), use `friend`.
- If the age line is blank, print just `Hello, NAME!`.
- Otherwise print `Hello, NAME! Next year you will be N.`
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
